text:
One secure workspace
for every branch
FlexPOS brings checkout, inventory, purchasing, accounting and analytics into one tenant-aware workspace.

◆  Built for branch-based operations and fast cashier workflows.
◆  Server-enforced money and stock movements with Supabase RLS.
◆  Responsive interface for desktop and smaller screens.

◆  Branded loading screen with a short 0–100% progress sequence.
◆  Email and password authentication through Supabase Auth.
◆  Responsive sign-in surface with recovery and account creation paths.
Authentication covers the full entry journey before a user reaches a business workspace.

◆  Create an account with email verification.
◆  Resend verification and request password recovery.
◆  Update password through the PKCE recovery flow.

◆  Business snapshot with net sales, gross profit, customer dues and expenses.
◆  Role, branch, currency and timezone context stays visible.
◆  Quick actions open the most common operational workflows.

◆  Search by product, SKU or barcode and add items to the current sale.
◆  Warehouse, register shift and customer context stay in the checkout panel.
◆  Cart totals, taxes, discounts and completion actions remain visible.

◆  Search, sorting, pagination and bulk selection across active SKUs.
◆  Product images, SKU, barcode, price and stock state appear together.
◆  Catalog actions support variants, pricing and stock tracking.

◆  Available quantities are shown per tracked SKU and warehouse.
◆  Stocktake, damage, transfer and adjustment actions are accessible at the top.
◆  Images keep the physical product easy to identify during operations.
Inventory movements stay auditable from the warehouse to the stock ledger.

◆  Record wastage, damage and manual corrections with a reason.
◆  Transfer quantities between warehouses and branches.
◆  Use stocktake workflows to reconcile physical counts.

◆  Recent sales are searchable by invoice number and date.
◆  Status filters separate paid, pending, refunded and cancelled orders.
◆  Receipt, tax invoice, returns and exchanges are available from each order.
Post-sale workflows keep the original sale traceable while correcting stock and payment outcomes.

◆  Return selected items or quantities from an invoice.
◆  Exchange items with a clear value difference.
◆  Keep return reasons and downstream ledger entries auditable.

◆  Customer records include contact details, groups and credit context.
◆  Search works across name, code, phone and email.
◆  Customer selection flows directly into POS checkout and ledger views.
CRM workflows extend the customer record beyond the point of sale.

◆  Track leads, opportunities and follow-ups in one tenant.
◆  Keep notes, reminders and quotations tied to the right customer.
◆  Use role-based access for customer data and activity.
Purchasing connects supplier records to the products and stock they replenish.

◆  Manage supplier contacts, terms and purchasing history.
◆  Create requisitions and purchase orders by branch or warehouse.
◆  Keep supplier lists searchable with shared data controls.
Inbound stock becomes a controlled, reviewable business process.

◆  Receive ordered quantities against a purchase order.
◆  Capture costs, taxes and discrepancies before stock is posted.
◆  Use goods receipts to maintain a reliable inventory trail.

◆  Customers, CRM, suppliers, expenses, accounting and reports are grouped by operational purpose.
◆  Shared navigation keeps the workspace predictable across modules.
◆  Each module follows tenant-aware permissions and data access.
Checkout supports the payment paths used by FlexPOS without cluttering the cashier workflow.

◆  Cash records an immediate tendered payment.
◆  UPI shows a bill-specific QR and requires a success or failed confirmation.
◆  Razorpay opens the real provider checkout in test mode.
The cashier can present the exact bill amount through the configured UPI address.

◆  UPI ID: kaushal.pithva@ptaxis.
◆  QR payload includes the bill value before checkout is finalized.
◆  Success records the payment; Failed leaves the sale unfinalized.
Razorpay uses the provider order and signature verification flow rather than a placeholder QR.

◆  The client requests a server-created Razorpay order.
◆  Checkout opens in test mode with provider callbacks.
◆  Server verification records the final payment state.
Every completed sale can produce a compact receipt or a tax-ready invoice.

◆  Small receipt output fits thermal printer widths.
◆  Tax invoice includes line items, tax splits and business context.
◆  Print and export flows are kept separate from sale completion.
A user signs in once and works inside the business context assigned by membership.

◆  Business, branch and membership relationships stay explicit.
◆  RLS policies scope reads and writes to the active tenant.
◆  The removed Orange Hotel tenant no longer appears in the workspace.
FlexPOS separates what a user can see from what they can do.

◆  System roles cover administration, cashier, inventory and accounting work.
◆  Memberships connect users to a business and role.
◆  Permission checks protect sensitive operations and management screens.
The same tenant model supports multiple operational locations.

◆  Branches carry timezone, contact and active-state configuration.
◆  Registers and shifts reconcile cash activity by location.
◆  Warehouse and register context follow the active branch.
Credit is treated as a ledger-backed balance rather than an informal note.

◆  Customer dues surface on dashboards and reports.
◆  Receipts and repayments update the ledger.
◆  Credit limits remain visible when selecting a customer in POS.
Operating expenses stay connected to the business and reporting period.

◆  Record expense categories, payees and amounts.
◆  Attach notes and supporting context where needed.
◆  Expense totals flow into management reporting.

◆  Chart of accounts, fiscal year and cash/bank tools share one control surface.
◆  Trial balance and GST summary are available from the accounting module.
◆  Operational entries and recurring expenses can be posted from the same screen.

◆  Net sales, expenses, customer dues and gross profit are available by period.
◆  Reports support 7-day, 30-day, 90-day and custom ranges.
◆  CSV, Excel and PDF export actions keep reporting portable.
Operational actions leave a trace that helps owners review changes.

◆  Tenant-scoped audit logs record important business operations.
◆  Sensitive actions require the relevant permission.
◆  History supports reconciliation, review and incident follow-up.
FlexPOS keeps hardware workflows online and explicit for a reliable counter experience.

◆  Camera and keyboard barcode input find products quickly.
◆  Printer and device bridges expose capability and heartbeat state.
◆  Physical scanner validation remains a deployment check for each device.
The product intentionally keeps the source of truth online instead of introducing an offline queue.

◆  Checkout, stock and payments require an authenticated connection.
◆  No deferred offline sales or background sync are enabled.
◆  Connectivity and authorization failures surface to the operator.
Production readiness is supported by a shared design system and repeatable checks.

◆  Responsive Material 3 surfaces keep desktop and mobile layouts aligned.
◆  Structured logs redact passwords, tokens and provider secrets.
◆  Analyzer, unit and integration checks protect core workflows.
The release workflow validates the paths that move money and stock.

◆  Auth, products, sales, returns and purchasing have integration coverage.
◆  Payment verification checks provider status and signatures.
◆  Concurrent sessions and hardware checks remain explicit release evidence.
FlexPOS can ship as a web or mobile application with environment-specific configuration.

◆  Supabase project configuration is supplied through environment files.
◆  Razorpay secrets stay server-side in Edge Functions.
◆  Signing, packaging and production smoke tests are part of the release checklist.
Tenant isolation is enforced at the database boundary, not only in the client.

◆  Public tables use row-level security with business-aware predicates.
◆  Service-role secrets never enter the Flutter client.
◆  Business deletion was scoped by exact tenant ID and verified afterward.
FlexPOS · Enterprise POS and business management
